snippet.title: Club Penguin Island - Official Launch Trailer | Disney Club Penguin Island
snippet.description:
Club Penguin Island - Official Launch Trailer | Disney Club Penguin Island

Where your adventures begin!

Discover a destination full of secrets and myths, legendary treasures, and piñata smashing penguins when you sign up for your account and choose your penguin name! On DISNEY’S Club Penguin Island, you can waddle around with friends, level-up, and quest for special rewards.

Learn more about Club Penguin Island today at www.clubpenguinisland.com

Download today: https://smart.link/58dbf55875446

All gameplay requires registration to create a Disney account, or sign in using an existing one.

Club Penguin Island offers recurring monthly membership subscription that costs real money. Most in-app features require this paid membership.

©2017 Disney
